text: 🚨🎙️| Gavi: “Atlético Madrid are a very difficult opponent with the quality to hurt us. We know how challenging these games are, and facing them is always like a battle. The atmosphere here is incredibly intense, arguably one of the best in Europe, which puts you under immense pressure. That’s why securing the win today was so important for us.” #fcblive

🚨🎙️| Hansi Flick: “We discussed the possibility of Frenkie de Jong playing at right-back before the previous match, and he was willing to help wherever the team needed him. The plan was for him to spend around 50 minutes at right-back before moving into midfield when Marc Bernal became tired. That’s exactly how things worked out, and I believe we made the right decision.” #fcblive
🚨🎙️| Hansi Flick: “On a scale of 1 to 10, how important is it for us to be top of the table? I’d say 10.” #fcblive

🚨🎙️| Xavi, on whether Frenkie de Jong is underrated: “Yes, but not by his teammates or coaches. If you ask his teammates who the best midfielder is, they’ll usually say Frenkie. You have to listen to them.

“Perhaps people don’t fully appreciate him because they don’t see him every day and only watch him from the outside. Sometimes, they fail to understand the tactical aspects of the game, such as how to pin opponents, apply pressure and create numerical advantages in both defence and attack. He’s a COMPLETE player.” #fcblive ⭐🇳🇱
